# Anima CLI reference

<!-- Generated by tools/cli-docs.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

This reference is generated from the command table used by `anima help`.

## Write

### `anima new`

scaffold an animation from a glyph, Glyphy project, or bundled sample

**Usage**

- `anima new <name> --glyph <file.svg> | --glyphy <project-dir> [-o out.animl] [--ani] [--force]`
- `anima new <directory> --sample bell|moon|progress`

**Options**

- `--glyph <file.svg>` — scaffold from an SVG glyph
- `--glyphy <project-dir>` — scaffold from a Glyphy project
- `--sample <name>` — copy a bundled sample project
- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--ani` — write canonical JSON instead of AniML
- `--force` — overwrite an existing scaffold output
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima new bell-copy --glyph fixtures/glyphs/bell.svg -o /tmp/bell-copy.animl` — scaffold AniML from the bell glyph
- `anima new /tmp/anima-sample --sample bell` — copy the bundled bell project

**See also:** `validate`, `inspect`, `docs authoring`

### `anima fmt`

format AniML or .ani canonically

**Usage**

- `anima fmt <file> [--write | --check]`

**Options**

- `--write` — replace the file with canonical formatting
- `--check` — check formatting without writing
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima fmt examples/bell.animl --check` — verify canonical AniML formatting
- `anima fmt examples/bell.ani` — print canonical JSON

**See also:** `validate`, `decompile`

### `anima import`

import supported SVG or Lottie features as AniML

**Usage**

- `anima import <file.svg|file.json> [-o out.animl]`

**Options**

- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima import fixtures/glyphs/bell.svg -o /tmp/bell-import.animl` — import the reference bell SVG

**See also:** `new`, `validate`

### `anima decompile`

write canonical AniML from a .ani document

**Usage**

- `anima decompile <file.ani> [-o out.animl]`

**Options**

- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima decompile examples/bell.ani -o /tmp/bell.animl` — convert the bell JSON document to AniML

**See also:** `build`, `fmt`

### `anima flatten`

convert text to outlines

**Usage**

- `anima flatten <file> [--node id] [-o out.ani] [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `--node <id>` — flatten only one text node
- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima flatten examples/bell.animl -o /tmp/bell-flat.ani` — flatten any text in the bell document

**See also:** `import-font`, `build`

### `anima library`

maintain vendored AniML library imports

**Usage**

- `anima library update <file.animl> [--check]`

**Options**

- `--check` — report stale vendored imports without changing files
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima library update examples/bell.animl --check` — check the bell library imports

**See also:** `build`, `validate`

## Check

### `anima validate`

validate a document and print every diagnostic

**Usage**

- `anima validate <file> [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima validate examples/bell.animl` — validate the reference AniML scene
- `anima validate examples/bell.ani --format=json` — emit machine-readable diagnostics

**See also:** `inspect`, `schema`

### `anima compare`

compare two PNG files by RGBA pixels

**Usage**

- `anima compare a.png b.png [--tolerance 0..255] [-o diff.png]`

**Options**

- `--tolerance <0..255>` — maximum channel difference before a pixel fails (default: 0)
- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima compare examples/moon-toggle.png examples/moon-toggle.png` — compare an image with itself

**See also:** `render`

### `anima bench`

measure compile and frame costs

**Usage**

- `anima bench <file> [-s script | -e "cmds"] [--frames N] [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `-s, --script <file>` — read script commands from a file
- `-e, --eval <cmds>` — run semicolon-separated script commands
- `--reduced-motion` — run with reduced motion enabled
- `--all` — include all values in snapshots
- `--semantics` — include semantic state in snapshots
- `--seed <N>` — set the uint32 script random seed
- `--frames <N>` — number of frames to benchmark (default: 600)
- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima bench examples/bell.animl --frames 60` — benchmark the bell for 60 frames

**See also:** `sample`, `render`

### `anima doctor`

check Node, browsers, cache, and module wiring

**Usage**

- `anima doctor`

**Options**

- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima doctor` — check the local Anima toolchain

**See also:** `playground`, `bundle`

## See

### `anima inspect`

inspect document structure, animation, inputs, and wiring

**Usage**

- `anima inspect <file> [--summary] [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `--summary` — print only wiring diagnostics
- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima inspect examples/bell.animl` — inspect the reference bell
- `anima inspect examples/bell.animl --summary` — show only wiring findings

**See also:** `validate`, `schema`

### `anima sample`

run a script and print snapshots as JSON lines

**Usage**

- `anima sample <file> [-s script | -e "cmds"] [--reduced-motion] [--all] [--semantics] [--seed N] [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `-s, --script <file>` — read script commands from a file
- `-e, --eval <cmds>` — run semicolon-separated script commands
- `--reduced-motion` — run with reduced motion enabled
- `--all` — include all values in snapshots
- `--semantics` — include semantic state in snapshots
- `--seed <N>` — set the uint32 script random seed
- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima sample examples/bell.animl -e "advance 0.2;snapshot"` — sample the bell after 0.2 seconds
- `anima sample examples/bell.animl -e "semantics;snapshot --semantics"` — inspect semantic output headlessly

**See also:** `session`, `docs authoring`

### `anima session`

run a persistent JSON-line script session

**Usage**

- `anima session <file> [--reduced-motion] [--all] [--semantics] [--seed N] [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `--reduced-motion` — run with reduced motion enabled
- `--all` — include all values in snapshots
- `--semantics` — include semantic state in snapshots
- `--seed <N>` — set the uint32 script random seed
- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima session examples/bell.animl` — open a persistent session for the bell

**See also:** `sample`, `bench`

### `anima render`

render frames, sheets, sequences, components, probes, or comparisons

**Usage**

- `anima render <file> -o out.svg|png|webm [--font name=path] [--at t] [-s script | -e "cmds"] [--size px]`
- `anima render <file> --compare glyph.svg [--size px] [--tolerance 0..255] [-o diff.png]`
- `anima render [file] [--component name] [--fit contain|cover|fill|none] [--viewport WxH] [--frames N] [--fps N] [--scale k] [--probe "x,y;x,y"] [--preset name] [--audio out.wav]`

**Options**

- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--browser-text` — render text through the browser font path
- `--component <name>` — render one component as the root
- `--fit <mode>` — fit the frame into the viewport (default: contain)
- `--viewport <WxH>` — set output viewport dimensions
- `--scale <k>` — scale inside the viewport, from 0 to 1 (default: 1)
- `--probe <x,y;x,y>` — sample final PNG pixels at coordinates
- `--preset <name>` — apply a project render preset (repeatable)
- `--fps <N>` — sequence frame rate (default: 60)
- `--audio <out.wav>` — mix captured audio events to WAV
- `-s, --script <file>` — read script commands from a file
- `-e, --eval <cmds>` — run semicolon-separated script commands
- `--reduced-motion` — run with reduced motion enabled
- `--all` — include all values in snapshots
- `--semantics` — include semantic state in snapshots
- `--seed <N>` — set the uint32 script random seed
- `--frames <N>` — render a frame sequence
- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--at <seconds>` — advance to a nonnegative time before rendering
- `--size <px>` — square render size (default: 240)
- `--sheet <N>` — render a labelled contact sheet
- `--over <seconds>` — contact-sheet time span
- `--dark` — use the dark render look
- `--color <slot=#hex>` — override a paint slot (repeatable)
- `--current <#hex>` — override currentColor
- `--background <#hex>` — set the output background
- `--compare <file.svg>` — compare one rendered frame with an SVG glyph
- `--tolerance <0..255>` — comparison channel tolerance (default: 0)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima render examples/bell.animl -o /tmp/bell.svg` — render the bell to SVG
- `anima render examples/bell.animl -o /tmp/bell.png --size 256` — render a 256px PNG
- `anima render examples/bell.animl --compare fixtures/glyphs/bell.svg` — compare the rest frame with the source glyph

**See also:** `inspect`, `compare`, `docs authoring`

### `anima docs`

read the authoring guide, format spec, markup spec, or module docs

**Usage**

- `anima docs [authoring | spec | markup | <section>] [section-slug] [--list | --full]`

**Options**

- `--list` — list available topics or sections
- `--full` — print a long section in full instead of its contents first
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima docs authoring the-loop` — read the core authoring loop
- `anima docs spec` — read the .ani format specification
- `anima docs markup` — read the AniML markup specification

**See also:** `schema`, `features`, `search`

### `anima schema`

inspect registry fields, types, spellings, and JSON Schema

**Usage**

- `anima schema [type | fill | stroke | a11y | timeline | layer | state | pose | transition | listener | input] [--all | --json-schema]`
- `anima schema --search <words> | <type>.<field> [--animatable] [--bindable] [--inherited] [--editor-only]`

**Options**

- `--search <words>` — search registry names and diagnostic codes
- `--animatable` — show animatable fields only
- `--bindable` — show bindable fields only
- `--inherited` — show inherited fields only
- `--editor-only` — show editor-only fields when applicable
- `--all` — print every type and field instead of the topic index
- `--json-schema` — print the complete generated JSON Schema
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima schema rect` — inspect rectangle fields and spellings
- `anima schema listener --format=json` — inspect listener fields as JSON
- `anima schema --search width` — search schema vocabulary

**See also:** `docs`, `search`

## Find

### `anima features`

list capabilities provided by Anima features

**Usage**

- `anima features [name]`

**Options**

- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima features` — list all feature names and summaries
- `anima features paint` — show what the paint feature provides

**See also:** `search`, `examples`, `docs`

### `anima search`

search the capability index

**Usage**

- `anima search <words…> [--kind k] [--limit n]`

**Options**

- `--kind <k>` — limit results to one or more entry kinds (repeatable)
- `--limit <n>` — maximum result count (default: 10)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima search "hover effect"` — find capabilities related to hover
- `anima search ik --kind capability --limit 5` — find IK capability rows

**See also:** `features`, `examples`, `docs`, `schema`

### `anima examples`

find, print, or copy example scenes

**Usage**

- `anima examples [topic|name] [--print | -o dir]`

**Options**

- `--print` — print one matching example file
- `-o, --out <dir>` — copy one matching example into a directory
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima examples bell` — find bell examples
- `anima examples bell --print` — print the matching bell example

**See also:** `features`, `search`

### `anima help`

show overview, command help, or the command table

**Usage**

- `anima help [command] [--all] [--json]`

**Options**

- `--all` — include hidden commands in the overview
- `--json` — print the command table as JSON
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima help` — show the grouped command overview
- `anima help render` — show render usage, options, and examples
- `anima help --json` — print the machine-readable command table

**See also:** `features`, `search`

## Ship

### `anima build`

compile AniML or export a self-contained local web build

**Usage**

- `anima build <file.animl|page.html> [-o out] [--embed] [--font name=path]`
- `anima build [file] --out-dir <directory> [--font name=path]`

**Options**

- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--out-dir <directory>` — export .ani, runtime, and HTML into a directory
- `--embed` — embed build assets into the compiled document
- `--font <name=path>` — install a local font for text measurement and rendering (repeatable)
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima build examples/bell.animl -o /tmp/bell.ani` — compile the bell to canonical JSON
- `anima build examples/bell.animl --out-dir /tmp/bell-site` — export a local web build

**See also:** `bundle`, `validate`

### `anima bundle`

bundle selected browser runtime modules

**Usage**

- `anima bundle [--modules paint,bind] [-o anima.js] [--verbose]`

**Options**

- `--modules <name,name>` — comma-separated runtime modules
- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--verbose` — print module size detail
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima bundle --modules paint,bind -o /tmp/anima.js` — bundle the paint and bind runtime modules

**See also:** `build`, `doctor`

### `anima completion`

generate shell completion from the command table

**Usage**

**Options**

- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima completion bash` — print Bash completion source

**See also:** `help`

### `anima version`

print the CLI package version

**Usage**

- `anima version`

**Options**

- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima version` — print the installed CLI version

**See also:** `help`

## Fonts and assets

### `anima import-font`

store, subset, or fetch a font at build time

**Usage**

- `anima import-font <font> -o local.ttf [--chars "ABC"]`
- `anima import-font --google "Family:wght@400;600" -o local.ttf [--chars "ABC"]`

**Options**

- `-o, --out <file>` — write output to a file
- `--google <family:axes@values>` — fetch a Google Font at build time
- `--chars <text>` — subset the font to these characters
- `--format <text|json>` — output format (default: text)
- `-h, --help` — show this command’s help

**Examples**

- `anima import-font fixtures/fonts/anima-test.ttf -o /tmp/anima-test.ttf --chars "Anima"` — subset the bundled test font

**See also:** `flatten`, `build`
